_schema.description: Per-product material qty rules. Each rule specifies how to compute a default quantity from TKO totals when the user adds the product to a project. Users can always override the calculated qty manually.
_schema.match_priority: 1. Exact default_code match (case-insensitive). 2. First name_pattern match. 3. Fallback to legacy estimateQty().
_schema.formula_fields: totals keys available: panels, area, perim, perimH, perimV, headFt, sillFt, jambFt, corners, setblks, dlJambs, spJambs, perimOverlap, perimInset, headFtInset, headFtOverlap.
_schema.rounding: All formulas wrap in Math.ceil() automatically — config should specify raw demand.

rules.description: Orazen Setblock Black (EST-1 row 97). One setblock per setblks count.
Orazen Stackable Setblock Black (EST-1 row 97 stacked).
Orazen Stackable Setblock Gray (EST-1 row 98 stacked).
Foam baffle, overlap-mount use case (EST-1 row 89, 1/4 x 1/2 cross-section). Quantity = perimeter of overlap-mount panels / (9ft per roll x 0.8 utilization).
Foam baffle, head retainer use case (EST-1 row 90, 1 x 1/2 cross-section). Quantity = head retainer length / (9ft per roll x 0.8 utilization).
Foam baffle, inset-mount use case (EST-1 row 91, 1/2 x 1/2 cross-section). Quantity = perimeter of inset-mount panels / (9ft per roll x 0.8 utilization).
Generic foam fallback when no mount-specific match. Quantity = total perimeter (overlap + inset) / (9ft per roll x 0.8 utilization). Conservative: covers any mount type.

Glazing tape for head retainer, inset-mount only (EST-1 row 96, 1/8 x 1). Quantity = head retainer length on inset-mount panels / (100ft per roll x ~0.91 utilization). If no inset panels in TKO, qty = 0 and user can override.
